I guess I'll get the discussion started here. What equipment do you use? I use a Nikon P600 for my photos, and for editing I mainly use the tools built into Preview on my Mac. I downloaded DeepSkyStacker, but I haven't really used it much yet. As an add-on question, what equipment do you wish you had? I wish I had a good telescope and a cheap DSLR.
What hardware and software do you use?
Um...none. Any suggestions for someone casually interested? Or someone at least interested in sources for completed pictures?

There's a wide range of equipment you could use, depending on how much you want to spend. I know some people have used a cell phone and telescope to take some pretty nice pictures. If you don't have a telescope already, one option would be to get a camera with superzoom capability, like the Nikon P600. If you go that route, you have to also get a tripod. Another option is to get a telescope with an adapter to replace the eyepiece with a DSLR. You could get a used DSLR on ebay for about $50, but I haven't looked into telescopes on ebay. I'd suggest you also check out /r/astrophotography on reddit. There's a lot of users over there, and they could probably help you a lot more than I can. Also, if you do a Google search for cheap astrophotography, a number of sites come up with some advice.

My hardware's not very impessive, I just have a little 90 Mak-Cass and a Nikon D7000, but I have gotten a few shots I'm proud of.

Software-wise:

PIPP for planetary cropping and centering

AviStack for alignment

RegiStax for wavelet sharpening

GIMP for levels/other post processing

Hardware:

  • Celestron 130EQ-md

  • 5" Newtonian Reflector

  • CG-3 mount

  • Nikon D3200

Software:

  • PIPP for centering, .tiff conversions

  • Registax for stacking, wavelets, histograms and gamma

  • Microsoft ICE for mosaics

  • Stellarium as a catalog of "Ooh what should I look at tonight?"

Alongside the 130EQ I've been using a Celestron TravelScope 70mm for large objects like Andromeda, Orion nebula, Pleiades and the like. But I dropped that in the Ocean and now it's out of factory alignment.
